verdict.rationale: Proa documents incremental adoption: you can proxy a single route to Proa while leaving the rest on Next.js or Rails, or call Proa over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby or Java. Its islands emit server-rendered HTML plus a small per-island JS module, which suits adding interactivity piecemeal. However, the documented adoption unit is a whole route or an FFI call. Nothing shows mounting interactive components inside an existing server-rendered HTML page you keep. Missing for 10: documented embedding of islands into an existing third-party-rendered page (e.g., a script-tag or mount-point workflow), an example of mixing Proa components into a legacy template, and hands-on corroboration.
